objective: Confirmed recruiter screens and interviews, then employment
notes: App subagents allowed by user; no paid API provisioning. Planner returns research/verification actions, never send authorization.
multichannel_note: Additive October 1 multi-channel layer (Naren request 2026-10-01). Plays are research/preparation proposals that share the existing per-company and daily caps; they never authorize sends, applications or new channels. See MULTICHANNEL_STRATEGY.md.

ats_scan.cadence: manual run, at most twice daily on outreach days; no scheduler installed

fresh_apply.note: Prepare the packet same day; Naren approves and submits. Applications remain a Naren decision.

referral_first_degree.note: Existing connections at the company; a referral ask needs Naren's per-message approval.

alumni.note: Routing question only on first touch; a referral ask only after they reply.

recruiter_linkedin.note: Requisition-owning recruiter; reference the requisition ID; standing v4 first-touch rules.

hiring_manager.note: Verified or clearly labeled likely manager from public sources; link the proof-of-work artifact.

community.note: Research job channels; any public post or DM needs Naren's approval and counts toward caps if it is a DM.

proof_of_work.note: Small team-specific artifact; independent work labeled independent; Naren reviews before sharing.

public_email.note: Only a recruiting inbox the employer printed publicly; never guessed or permuted; never in parallel with an open LinkedIn route.
